CLI-DEP.title: CLI depend add / depend remove / critical-path

CLI-DESCRIBE.title: CLI task describe command (.rustwerk/tasks/<ID>.md)
CLI-DESCRIBE.description: Add 'task describe <ID>' command that reads/writes .rustwerk/tasks/<ID>.md markdown files. 'task describe <ID>' shows the file contents. 'task describe <ID> --edit' opens or creates the file. 'task show' could also display the description if the file exists. Convention: files are named by task ID in uppercase.

CLI-DEV-ADD.title: CLI dev add — add developer to project

CLI-DEV-LIST.title: CLI dev list — list all developers

CLI-JSON.title: Global --json output flag for all commands

CLI-TAG-FILTER.title: Add --tag filter to task list
CLI-TAG-FILTER.description: Add --tag filter option to 'task list' command. Filter tasks that have the specified tag. Support multiple --tag flags for AND filtering.

CLI-TAG-SET.title: Add --tags flag to task add and update
CLI-TAG-SET.description: Add --tags flag to 'task add' and 'task update' commands. Accept comma-separated tag list. Validate tag format (lowercase alphanumeric with hyphens).

CLI-TASK.title: CLI task add / remove / update / status

CLI-VIZ.title: CLI list, tree, gantt, status commands

DEP-CRIT.title: Critical path analysis (longest-path on weighted DAG)

DEP-GUARD.title: Prevent removal of tasks with dependents

DEV-ASSIGN.title: Link task assign to validated developer IDs

DOM-ADD.title: Add task to project (domain method + ID generation)

DOM-TAG.title: Add tags field to task model
DOM-TAG.description: Add an optional tags field (Vec<String>) to the Task domain model. Update serialization/deserialization to support tags in project.json. Tags should be lowercase, alphanumeric with hyphens.

GIT-ATOMIC.title: Atomic commit and push with rollback

GIT-WIRE.title: Wire git into mutating CLI commands

PLG-API.title: Plugin API crate with DTOs and FFI contract
PLG-API.description: Create rustwerk-plugin-api crate: PluginInfo, PluginResult, TaskPushResult, TaskDto structs. Define 4 extern C function signatures (api_version, plugin_info, push_tasks, free_string). API_VERSION constant. Helper functions for plugin authors.

PLG-API-STATE.title: Per-task plugin-state round-trip in the plugin API
PLG-API-STATE.description: Round-trip per-task plugin-state through TaskDto and project.json; bump API_VERSION to 2.

PLG-CLI.title: CLI plugin list and push subcommands
PLG-CLI.description: Add Plugin command to main.rs with List and Push actions. plugin list discovers and shows plugins. plugin push <name> --project-key PROJ [--tasks T1,T2] pushes tasks. Config assembly from env vars (JIRA_URL, JIRA_TOKEN), git user.email, CLI args.

PLG-DISP.title: Plugin host dispatcher module
PLG-DISP.description: New host-side dispatcher that each domain command calls after a successful local mutation. Reads plugin_state.<plugin>.key, decides create vs update vs skip, and calls the existing push_all FFI for the affected task. Foundation for every later wire-up; design carefully because regret here means revisiting every wire-up.

PLG-DOCS.title: Documentation sweep for new invocation model
PLG-DOCS.description: Update docs/manual.md, llms.txt, and knowledge/integrations/jira-plugin.md to reflect the implicit-invocation model. Flip the ADR (knowledge/decisions/plugin-invocation-model.md) status from 'Accepted, not yet implemented' to current state.

PLG-GATE.title: Two-state create gate logic
PLG-GATE.description: Implement the asymmetric create gate: a task transitions from pre-push to post-push the first time its status becomes in_progress (assignee not required). Pre-push mutations push nothing; post-push mutations push every time. Observable from plugin_state.<plugin>.key.is_some().

PLG-HOST.title: Plugin host with libloading dynamic loader
PLG-HOST.description: Add plugin_host.rs to binary with #[allow(unsafe_code)]. LoadedPlugin struct wrapping libloading::Library. Plugin discovery in .rustwerk/plugins/, ~/.rustwerk/plugins/, and target/. Platform-specific extension filter (.dll/.so/.dylib). API version check. String memory management via plugin's free_string.

PLG-HOST-E2E.title: Load-discover-invoke integration test
PLG-HOST-E2E.description: Integration test that builds the jira cdylib and drives plugin list + push --dry-run against it.

PLG-INSTALL-BUILD.title: Build-from-source variants of rustwerk plugin install
PLG-INSTALL-BUILD.description: Build-from-source variants for rustwerk plugin install: accept a Cargo project dir or --from <package-name>, plus --release. Reuse the existing copy/verify/rollback pipeline after cargo build.

PLG-JIRA.title: Jira plugin crate (cdylib) with REST client
PLG-JIRA.description: Create rustwerk-jira-plugin crate as cdylib. Implement 4 FFI exports. Jira REST client using ureq (sync). HTTP Basic Auth (email:token). Direct URL first, Platform API Gateway fallback for scoped tokens. Cloud ID from _edge/tenant_info.

PLG-JIRA-E2E.title: Live-Jira smoke test
PLG-JIRA-E2E.description: Opt-in live-Jira integration test gated on RUSTWERK_JIRA_TEST_* env vars.

PLG-JIRA-FIELDS.title: Richer Jira field mapping
PLG-JIRA-FIELDS.description: Map rustwerk status, assignee, complexity, and tags onto Jira fields via config maps.

PLG-JIRA-ISSUETYPE.title: Per-task Jira issue type
PLG-JIRA-ISSUETYPE.description: Per-task Jira issue type (Task/Epic/Story/Sub-task) — unblocks hierarchical WBS push.

PLG-JIRA-PARENT.title: Parent / epic linking for Jira push
PLG-JIRA-PARENT.description: Parent linking — push parent.key on children so rustwerk WBS hierarchy lands as Jira epic→task→sub-task.

PLG-JIRA-STATE.title: Remember the Jira issue key per task
PLG-JIRA-STATE.description: Jira plugin records the created issue key in plugin_state.jira on successful push.

PLG-JIRA-UPDATE.title: Idempotent push — update existing Jira issues
PLG-JIRA-UPDATE.description: Idempotent push: PUT existing issues using stored key; recreate on 404.

PLG-LINK.title: plugin link single-task binding
PLG-LINK.description: rustwerk plugin link <task-id> <jira-key>. Validates key syntax, GETs the issue against the configured Jira project to confirm it exists, then writes plugin_state.jira = { key, self, last_pushed_at } to the task. Refuses if the key 404s. Sole command in the design that writes plugin_state without performing a push.

PLG-LINK-BULK.title: plugin link --bulk batched form
PLG-LINK-BULK.description: Batched variant: validates every key against Jira before writing any binding. Atomic — partial bootstraps do not leave half the project linked. Input format: CSV or JSON file mapping rustwerk task IDs to Jira keys.

PLG-MAP.title: Task-to-Jira issue mapping (ADF format)
PLG-MAP.description: Map TaskDto to Jira issue creation payload. POST /rest/api/3/issue. Description in Atlassian Document Format. Project key from config. Issue type defaults to Task.

PLG-NOPLUG.title: --no-plugins escape flag
PLG-NOPLUG.description: CLI-level flag that suppresses plugin invocation for the current command. Sole supported escape; no ambient env-var toggle (silent suppression would let drift accumulate invisibly).

PLG-RECON.title: Rename plugin push to plugin reconcile
PLG-RECON.description: Rename the existing operator-facing verb. Default behavior respects the create gate: only post-push tasks (have a key) plus tasks currently in_progress are pushed. Reconcile becomes a diagnostic / bulk-repair escape hatch, not the primary surface.

PLG-RECON-FORCE.title: reconcile --force-create-all flag
PLG-RECON-FORCE.description: Loud flag that bypasses the create gate during reconcile. Specifically for the bootstrapping case where rustwerk is the source and Jira starts empty — every task gets a Jira issue regardless of state. Kept explicit because force-creating hundreds of issues should require an obvious operator gesture.

PLG-RETRY.title: Retry queue with opportunistic drain
PLG-RETRY.description: On plugin failure: commit the local mutation, append the failure to plugin_state.<plugin>.pending on the affected task, exit non-zero with a message naming the queued work. Drain the queue opportunistically when any subsequent event fires for the same task.

PLG-WIRE-ALL.title: Wire dispatcher into remaining mutating commands
PLG-WIRE-ALL.description: Fan out the dispatcher call to task add, task assign, task unassign, task update (title/desc/tags), task depend, task undepend. Once a task is post-push, every mutation pushes the full snapshot.

PLG-WIRE-STATUS.title: Wire dispatcher into task status set
PLG-WIRE-STATUS.description: First end-to-end wire-up: task status set fires the dispatcher after a successful local mutation. Smallest slice that proves the whole architecture (dispatcher + gate + FFI + Jira round-trip) works together. Includes the 'first in_progress creates the issue' path.

PLG-WORKSPACE.title: Wire plugin crates into workspace
PLG-WORKSPACE.description: Add rustwerk-plugin-api and rustwerk-jira-plugin to workspace members. Add libloading (optional, behind plugins feature) and rustwerk-plugin-api deps to main crate. Crate-level unsafe_code overrides for plugin crates.

QRY-LIST.title: List tasks with filters (status, assignee, chain)

VIZ-AXIS.title: Upgrade Gantt time axis to box-drawing chars

VIZ-UNICODE.title: Upgrade Gantt bars to Unicode blocks with bar caps
